title: TikTok Shop Return Triage Ledger
oneLiner: A margin-defense desk for TikTok Shop sellers drowning in returns, fund holds, and settlement-line confusion.
targetUser: Small TikTok Shop sellers, creator-commerce brands, and agency operators who reconcile returns, payouts, affiliate commissions, restock decisions, and shop-score risk.
keyUX: Paste settlement lines or return records, sort each return into resell, partial refund, dispute, or loss bucket, then export a margin defense packet with deadlines, evidence gaps, and shop-score impact.
searchSignals: S1 Reddit r/TikTokshop seller alleges stolen funds and backend data manipulation: https://www.reddit.com/r/TikTokshop/comments/1tmear8/tiktok_shop_has_stolen_money_and_manipulated_back/
S2 Reddit r/TikTokshop returns destroying seller margins: https://www.reddit.com/r/TikTokshop/comments/1qc0qbu/returns_are_destroying_my_margins_on_tiktok_shop/
S3 SellerOps TikTok Shop return/refund defense guidance: https://sellerops.io/tiktok-shop-returns-refund-defense/
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app prototype called "TikTok Shop Return Triage Ledger" for small TikTok Shop sellers, creator-commerce brands, and marketplace agencies. The app should help an operator paste settlement lines or return records, triage each return into resell, partial refund, dispute, or loss, and export a margin defense packet before platform deadlines. Required sections: seller health header, return inbox with deadline status, settlement-line parser, item inspection decision panel, margin and fee waterfall, evidence checklist, platform appeal packet, and weekly loss prevention summary. Use realistic ecommerce sample data, warning states for fund holds and shop-score damage, and clear operator actions. Design direction: use the `operator-dense` profile with compact tables, sharp status chips, slate/charcoal work surfaces, high-contrast deadline accents, and practical controls that feel like a serious seller operations cockpit rather than a generic dashboard.
